name: Cursor
free_tier_summary: Free Hobby plan with limited Agent requests and Composer access.
free_tier_limits: Hobby includes limited Agent requests; the official page gives no numeric quota.
pricing_notes: Individual (Pro) is $20/month; Pro+ and Ultra are higher individual tiers. Teams are $40/user/month; Enterprise is custom. Usage beyond the included amount is billed on demand, in arrears.
tagline: AI code editor for codebase-aware edits and agent workflows.
summary: Cursor is a code editor with AI chat and agents that can work across a whole project. You give it instructions, attach the relevant files, and review the changes it proposes.
how_it_helps: Use it to make code changes, investigate bugs, or work through multi-file tasks while keeping your project open in the editor.
pros: The free plan does not require a card.
You can attach files, folders, terminal output and diffs as context.
Supports persistent project and team rules.
cons: Free-plan Agent limits are not quantified on the pricing page.
Paid usage can continue as metered on-demand billing.
The pricing page does not state free-plan commercial-use terms.

prompt_style.technique: State the task clearly and attach known relevant context; use project rules for persistent guidance.
prompt_style.format: Natural-language chat prompt, optionally with @-attached files, folders, terminal output or diffs.
rules: Be clear about the intended task.
Use @ mentions when you know which files are relevant.
Use rules for repeated project guidance.
prompt_style.example: Inspect @src/auth.ts and the related tests. Fix the login redirect bug without changing unrelated behavior, then run the relevant tests.

best_for: Developers who want an AI assistant to inspect and edit a local codebase from an editor.
not_for: People who want a no-code website builder or a published, quantified free agent quota.
